vectors.name: formats-yaml/line-breaks/nel-is-written-as-the-n-escape-and-reported
vectors.comment: E-34: a string value holding U+0085 is written double-quoted with the escape `\N`, never as the raw character, and the writer reports format.string-line-break-char at the Document path of the leaf. The expected text is `a: "x\Ny"`.

vectors.name: formats-yaml/line-breaks/n-escape-reads-back-as-the-single-character
vectors.comment: E-34's reverse direction: `\N` in a double-quoted YAML scalar is the one character U+0085, so the written text reads back as the original string.
